grade9v3:question_repairs.clarify: Separate supplied bond equivalence from a permanently chosen Lewis double bond.
grade9v3:question_repairs.connect: Equivalent contributors are bookkeeping alternatives for one delocalised description.

grade9v3:question_repairs.rule: Planar equivalent nitrate bonds reject one permanently unique N=O position. N sigma framework is locally sp2; equivalence alone is not the hybridisation criterion.

grade9v3:question_repairs.clarify: Translate formal contributors into one sigma framework and a complete pi-space ledger.
grade9v3:question_repairs.connect: A formal Lewis double bond does not identify the whole delocalised occupancy.
grade9v3:question_repairs.way: List the central and terminal perpendicular p contributions and preserve one set of nuclear positions.
grade9v3:question_repairs.rule: Nitrate has three in-plane N-O sigma directions and four perpendicular p functions spanning a six-electron pi space. Contributors do not switch in time.
grade9v3:question_repairs.check: Changed check: 24 total valence electrons = 18 in sigma/in-plane lone-pair bookkeeping plus six in the perpendicular pi space.
grade9v3:question_repairs.probe: For nitrate and carbonate, count pi-space electrons including terminal perpendicular lone pairs. Do formal contributors describe alternating nuclear structures?
grade9v3:question_repairs.pattern: Six pi-space electrons in each; no switching of nuclear structures. Repeated two-electron pi totals expose omitted lone-pair contributions.
grade9v3:question_repairs.transfer: Translate carbonate contributors into a continuous p-space description.
grade9v3:question_repairs.wrong_idea: Resonance contributors are molecular structures switching in time; only the drawn double bond supplies pi electrons.
grade9v3:question_repairs.label: Q2

grade9v3:question_repairs.clarify: Include the terminal-oxygen contributions when describing carbonate pi occupancy.
grade9v3:question_repairs.connect: Formal charge averages and physical partial charges have different meanings.
grade9v3:question_repairs.way: Keep sigma/in-plane and perpendicular-p ledgers separate; identify what a contributor average actually averages.
grade9v3:question_repairs.rule: Carbonate has three in-plane sigma bonds and four perpendicular p functions holding six pi-space electrons. Average formal O charge -2/3 is contributor bookkeeping, not a uniquely measured atomic partial charge.
grade9v3:question_repairs.check: Independent ledger: CO3^2- has 24 valence electrons; three sigma pairs and six in-plane O lone pairs use eighteen, leaving six in the pi space.
grade9v3:question_repairs.probe: How many carbonate pi-space electrons arise from one C=O pi pair plus two perpendicular O lone pairs? Does averaging formal charges measure physical partial charges?
grade9v3:question_repairs.pattern: Six; no. Repeated two-electron count or measured-charge claim exposes the two distinct errors.
grade9v3:question_repairs.transfer: Explain why equal bond lengths do not uniquely determine atomic partial charges.
grade9v3:question_repairs.wrong_idea: A delocalised carbonate pi space contains only one pair; formal charge averages are measured partial charges.
grade9v3:question_repairs.label: Q7

grade9v3:question_repairs.clarify: Assign local bases before deducing the relation between terminal planes.
grade9v3:question_repairs.connect: A central sp carbon retains two perpendicular p directions.
grade9v3:question_repairs.way: Match each central p direction with an aligned terminal p direction; infer terminal sigma planes yourself.
grade9v3:question_repairs.rule: Allene uses terminal sp2, central sp accounting. The two central perpendicular p directions support perpendicular terminal CH2 planes in the introductory model.
grade9v3:question_repairs.check: Changed check: looking down C=C=C, terminal CH2 planes project at right angles; rotating the whole model leaves that relation unchanged.
grade9v3:question_repairs.probe: Compare ethene with allene: how many residual p directions are needed at the centre, and which planes must align with each?
grade9v3:question_repairs.pattern: Ethene uses one aligned pi pair; allene central carbon uses two perpendicular p directions. Repeating a single planar p direction for both exposes the mapping error.
grade9v3:question_repairs.transfer: Build the allene end-on projection from the two p directions.
grade9v3:question_repairs.wrong_idea: All double-bonded fragments must share one plane.
grade9v3:question_repairs.label: Q3

grade9v3:question_repairs.clarify: Explain the terminal-plane constraint using overlap geometry, not an invalid occupation claim.
grade9v3:question_repairs.connect: Atomic basis functions participate in molecular combinations; Pauli exclusion is an electron-state rule.
grade9v3:question_repairs.way: Name the two inter-centre pi overlaps and compare their directions.
grade9v3:question_repairs.rule: Allene central sp accounting retains two perpendicular p functions. Terminal sigma planes are perpendicular to their respective p functions. Do not claim the first p orbital is filled by one bond and forbidden from multicentre participation by Pauli.
grade9v3:question_repairs.check: Changed check: a delocalised nitrate p function participates in a multicentre description, falsifying the claimed one-AO-one-bond prohibition.
grade9v3:question_repairs.probe: Does forming a pi contribution make an atomic p function unavailable to every multicentre molecular combination? Contrast allene direction constraints with nitrate delocalisation.
grade9v3:question_repairs.pattern: No. Allene uses distinct perpendicular local p directions in its model; nitrate is multicentre. A persistent forbidden-reuse claim identifies the faulty warrant.
grade9v3:question_repairs.transfer: Explain allene perpendicularity without using the phrase orbital already occupied.
grade9v3:question_repairs.wrong_idea: Pauli exclusion forbids one atomic orbital from participating in any multicentre description.
grade9v3:question_repairs.label: Q4

grade9v3:question_repairs.clarify: Separate persistence of the axial sigma connection from claims about all electronic interactions.
grade9v3:question_repairs.connect: Relative p alignment affects pi overlap; one axial sketch is not a total-energy decomposition.
grade9v3:question_repairs.way: Rotate relative groups while holding the central bond axis fixed; state only what this model supports.
grade9v3:question_repairs.rule: Ethane axial C-C sigma bonding can persist through torsion; ethene pi alignment changes under twist. Other interactions, including hyperconjugation, can change; an exclusively steric total-energy account is unjustified.
grade9v3:question_repairs.check: Changed check: a fixed central sigma direction does not hold every C-H/donor-acceptor orientation fixed.
grade9v3:question_repairs.probe: During ethane rotation, does an unchanged C-C axis guarantee unchanged orientation of every neighbouring orbital? Compare ethene p alignment.
grade9v3:question_repairs.pattern: No; ethene relative p alignment also changes. A whole-molecule no-overlap-change claim reveals model overextension.
grade9v3:question_repairs.transfer: Explain the sigma/pi contrast without assigning a universal torsional energy cause.
grade9v3:question_repairs.wrong_idea: A fixed central sigma axis means every molecular interaction is unchanged.
grade9v3:question_repairs.label: Q8

grade9v3:question_repairs.clarify: Trace the continuous aligned p pathway rather than counting all double bonds.
grade9v3:question_repairs.connect: An intervening saturated sp3 centre breaks the ordinary contiguous pi pathway in this model.
grade9v3:question_repairs.way: Mark p-bearing centres and inspect adjacency before declaring conjugation.
grade9v3:question_repairs.rule: Butadiene has four contiguous p-bearing centres; a central saturated CH2 in separated pentadiene interrupts this introductory pathway. This is not a proof of zero interaction of every quantum-mechanical kind.
grade9v3:question_repairs.check: Changed check: replacing the saturated spacer with an appropriate unsaturated p-bearing centre restores a contiguous path.
grade9v3:question_repairs.probe: Compare CH2=CH-CH=CH2 with CH2=CH-CH2-CH=CH2. Does spatial closeness alone repair the missing p pathway?
grade9v3:question_repairs.pattern: No; the first has a continuous path, the second an sp3 interruption. Repeated proximity-based claims reveal the misconception.
grade9v3:question_repairs.transfer: Specify a structural change that restores the pathway and a model limitation.
grade9v3:question_repairs.wrong_idea: Spatial closeness repairs an interrupted p pathway.
grade9v3:question_repairs.label: Q9

grade9v3:question_repairs.clarify: Evaluate bond equivalence as a criterion rather than as a conclusion.
grade9v3:question_repairs.connect: Equivalent bond properties and local orbital-basis selection are separate statements.
grade9v3:question_repairs.way: Test the rule on equivalent-bond examples with different central domain counts.
grade9v3:question_repairs.rule: Equivalent bonds do not imply sp2: CO2 carbon is sp, nitrate N sp2, and NH3 N sp3-like in their introductory models.
grade9v3:question_repairs.check: Changed check: CH4 has equivalent C-H bonds but four carbon directions, contradicting equality-implies-sp2.

grade9v3:question_repairs.pattern: Four versus two domains refute the shared label. Repeating sp2 solely from equivalence identifies criterion confusion.
grade9v3:question_repairs.transfer: Write a qualified hybridisation procedure whose inputs exclude bond equivalence as a sufficient test.

grade9v3:question_repairs.clarify: Assign each carbon locally and count sigma/pi components across the whole structure.
grade9v3:question_repairs.connect: A triple bond supplies one sigma plus two pi components.
grade9v3:question_repairs.way: Number the three carbons; inventory local directions and count every connected atom pair once for sigma.
grade9v3:question_repairs.rule: Propyne CH3-C≡CH has carbon labels sp3, sp, sp; four C-H plus two C-C sigma bonds gives six sigma, and the triple bond gives two pi.
grade9v3:question_repairs.check: Independent electron ledger: C3H4 has 16 valence electrons; six sigma pairs plus two pi pairs account for sixteen.
grade9v3:question_repairs.probe: Count sigma bonds in propyne, then in ethyne. Do double/triple bond lines each count as additional sigma bonds?
grade9v3:question_repairs.pattern: Propyne six, ethyne three; multiplicity adds pi components. Repeated sigma=line-counting indicates the wrong rule.
grade9v3:question_repairs.transfer: Classify each carbon and count bond components in ethyne.
grade9v3:question_repairs.wrong_idea: Each triple-bond line is a sigma bond.
grade9v3:question_repairs.label: Q6

grade9v3:question_repairs.clarify: Synthesize a local procedure that also checks inter-centre compatibility.
grade9v3:question_repairs.connect: Local count, residual p directions and model applicability have different jobs.
grade9v3:question_repairs.way: Apply the same ordered inventory to each atom, then check neighbouring overlaps; preserve boundaries.
grade9v3:question_repairs.rule: Count local sigma directions and lone pairs, conserve the valence basis, check residual p orientation and neighbouring compatibility, then qualify applicability. Propyne/allene classifications are atom-local.
grade9v3:question_repairs.check: Changed check: the procedure must return allene sp2/sp/sp2 and propyne sp3/sp/sp while conserving four carbon basis functions at each site.

grade9v3:question_repairs.pattern: No; the positions differ. Repeating one molecule-wide label identifies failure to localise the procedure.
grade9v3:question_repairs.transfer: State the evidence that would require revisiting a localized lone-pair assignment.

misconceptions.wrong_idea: Bond equivalence by itself implies sp2.
misconceptions.diagnostic_prompt: Apply the proposed equality-implies-sp2 rule to CH4 and CO2, then compare it with a domain inventory.
misconceptions.repair: Equivalent bonds do not imply sp2: CO2 carbon is sp, nitrate N sp2, and NH3 N sp3-like in their introductory models.

misconceptions.wrong_idea: Each triple-bond line is a sigma bond.
misconceptions.diagnostic_prompt: Count sigma bonds in propyne, then in ethyne. Do double/triple bond lines each count as additional sigma bonds?
misconceptions.repair: Propyne CH3-C≡CH has carbon labels sp3, sp, sp; four C-H plus two C-C sigma bonds gives six sigma, and the triple bond gives two pi.

misconceptions.wrong_idea: A whole molecule has one hybridisation label.
misconceptions.diagnostic_prompt: Can a whole molecule have one hybridisation label? Run a local ledger for allene and propyne.
misconceptions.repair: Count local sigma directions and lone pairs, conserve the valence basis, check residual p orientation and neighbouring compatibility, then qualify applicability. Propyne/allene classifications are atom-local.

exit_task.prompt: Apply the local procedure to propyne and allene. Does one label fit every carbon?

answer.summary: No. Propyne is locally sp3/sp/sp; allene is sp2/sp/sp2, and those assignments leave the p orbitals required by their pi bonds.
